traps.wrong: The story of the patient in bed 14 is repeated or planned as content with details that could identify him (the bed, the initial or the drug).
traps.truth: It may be told only with nothing that could identify anyone, and otherwise left out.

traps.wrong: The photograph of the ward whiteboard is planned as a picture on the site.
traps.truth: It shows patients' initials and bed numbers and cannot be shown.

traps.wrong: She raised barcode scanning from 71% to 94% herself.
traps.truth: The ward did, with pharmacy and IT. Her part was the observation, finding the three workarounds, and getting the scanners moved.

traps.wrong: "Clinical Informatics Lead" is used as her job title, though her own note says what she is on paper.
traps.truth: She is a CNM1, and Nursing Informatics Link Nurse one day a week.

traps.wrong: The hospital's name or logo is planned for the site without asking whether she may use it.
traps.truth: She may name the hospital and may not use its logo.
